prompts.armorite_ore: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single transparent inventory icon for the existing Pokemon Calvo game. Image 1 (armorite_ore.png) is the exact object/identity reference: Duralium / Armorite Ore. Image 2 (fire_stone.png) is STYLE ONLY, never copy its subject or fire symbol. Re-illustrate the first icon with smooth clean contours and the restrained illustrated volume of the second. Preserve the original upright squat irregular faceted nugget silhouette, purple/lilac central mineral, pale near-white lavender outer facets/rim, diagonal upper-left light and darker lower-right purple facets. This is a single small rough mineral nugget, not jewelry, not a cut diamond, not a round medallion, not a magical crystal cluster. Keep the original broad facet layout and original outline proportions as faithfully as possible; invent no spikes or extra inclusions. Moderately dark thin outline, simple smooth shading, restrained white highlight, no photorealistic surface texture. It must remain identifiable when reduced to 48 and 32 pixels alongside the supplied inventory artwork. Centered whole object, roughly 80 percent canvas height, square canvas, transparent alpha outside the object. No text, labels, border, checkerboard, cast ground shadow, glow, scenery or other objects. Create only ONE icon.
